topic: Handling accumulated messages in raw_seen_dead queue
summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding 190,000 accumulated messages in the `raw_seen_dead` queue on RMQ. Initially, one participant suggested re-queuing them into `raw_seen`, as this is a common practice and might allow processing of more recent data. However, another participant noted that the queue is primarily used for real-time sessions. Consequently, it was decided to discard (or 'kill') the accumulated messages to prevent increasing entropy and maintain system stability.
decisions: Discard 190,000 accumulated messages from the raw_seen_dead queue.
